result:
UI audit complete. **1 defect found, fixed, and verified.**

## The defect — `50fde1b`

The `/storm-map` time-range dropdown had **no hover state at all**.

`.map-controls__dropdown-trigger` (`index.css:2772`) contained a verbatim copy-paste of the `.glass` block, with `!important` added to two lines — on an element that already carries `className="map-controls__dropdown-trigger glass"` (`MapControls.jsx:38`), so the copy was pure redundancy. But `!important` inverts the cascade: it beats higher specificity, later source order *and* inline styles. Those two lines silently killed both the rule's own values five lines below **and the entire `:hover` rule**. With no `transform` in that hover rule to fall back on, the control gave zero feedback.

Proven with a real `page.mouse.move` (`hoverCount: 11`, `matches(':hover') === true`): background and border were byte-identical at rest and hovered. An injected probe confirmed the mechanism — even an *inline* hover colour computed back to `--glass-bg`. After deleting the 4 lines, hover moves and reverts correctly, the box is unchanged at 95×38, and the trigger's border now matches its own dropdown menu exactly, which it hadn't before.

## Why six prior sweeps missed it

Runs 92/94/98/101 attacked this same "a declaration silently loses" family, but all keyed on **specificity or source order**. `!important` beats both, so every one of them scored a `base{p:!important}` / `base:hover{p}` pair as *"the hover wins"* and passed it.

## The charter's named gap was empty

Run 101 named "inline style vs `@media` / `[data-*]` / `[aria-*]`" as the top unrun check. `index.css` is the app's only stylesheet and has **exactly one `@media`** (mobile, out of charter) and **zero attribute selectors**. One `grep -c` retires it — I've recorded "measure a gap's surface area before budgeting a run for it" as a standing lesson, and pivoted to three never-run checks instead (all self-tested with negative controls, all committed in `08d14b0`).

## Everything else

- **Audits 1–7 regression-clean on 18 routes** in one browser call — confirming Runs 93/94/98 that the static 7 are converged. Not re-spent.
- **Mirror check closed**: 59,152 inline declarations probed across 19 routes for `!important` overrides — 0 app defects. The only two hits are a mapbox sub-pixel artifact and the deliberate recharts dark-mode legend override.
- **0 duplicate JSX attributes and 0 duplicate inline-style keys** app-wide (a duplicate `onClick` would be a dead handler no rendering check could see).

Three findings I deliberately did **not** touch, with reasoning in the record: the 5 `.nav-link` `!important` pairs are value-identical no-ops (deliberate UA-chrome suppression — the in-source comment shows the author understood the mechanism); the 3 `TasksView` shorthand hits are inside the `isMobile` branch and mobile is paused; and form-label drift remains a developer call.

Build PASS (7.77s), zero DB writes, nothing left uncommitted. Full record at `C:/tmp/ui-audit-results.txt`; `overnight_resume.md`, `qa_standing_gotchas.md` and the `MEMORY.md` index are updated for the next run.
